adb: -s 192.168.43.1:5555 shell am force-stop com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller; am start -n com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller/org.firstinspires.ftc.robotcontroller.internal.PermissionValidatorWrapper -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER
-s 192.168.43.1:5555 shell logcat -d -v threadtime -T '11-12 10:00:00.000' | grep -F -e '======= INIT FINISH ======='
reinstall:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
port="${ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT:-5037}"
if [ -n "${ADB_SERVER_SOCKET:-}${ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
  echo "STOPPED: ADB_SERVER_SOCKET or ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_ADDRESS is set, which can point adb at another adb server and so another hub: unset it and rerun. Nothing was sent to any hub." >&2
  exit 1
fi
rc=0
owners=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN -Fcp) || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && { [ "$rc" -ne 1 ] || [ -n "$owners" ]; }; then
  echo "STOPPED: lsof couldn't list what listens on adb's port $port (exit $rc). Nothing was sent to any hub." >&2
  exit 1
fi
others=$(printf '%s\n' "$owners" | awk '
  function flush() { if (pid != "" && cmd != "adb") printf "%s%s (pid %s)", (n++ ? ", " : ""), (cmd == "" ? "a process lsof did not name" : cmd), pid }
  /^p/ { flush(); pid = substr($0, 2); cmd = "" }
  /^c/ { cmd = substr($0, 2) }
  END { flush() }')
if [ -n "$others" ]; then
  echo "STOPPED: $others listening on port $port, where adb looks for its server, so every adb command would go to whatever is behind it, possibly another hub. Stop it (an ssh port forward, for one), check that lsof -nP -iTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN shows nothing or adb, and rerun. Nothing was sent to any hub." >&2
  exit 1
fi
"<root>/stubs/adb" connect 192.168.43.1:5555 || true
"<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 wait-for-device
"<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 install -r -t -d "<root>/common/bench-backups/<time>/apk/base.apk"
"<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 shell "rm -rf /storage/emulated/0/FIRST/dairy/sloth/*"
"<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 push "<root>/common/bench-backups/<time>/rc_preferences.xml" /data/local/tmp/bench_rc_prefs.xml
out=$("<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 shell "am force-stop com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller && run-as com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller cp /data/local/tmp/bench_rc_prefs.xml shared_prefs/com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller_preferences.xml && echo PREFS_OK; rm -f /data/local/tmp/bench_rc_prefs.xml")
case "$out" in *PREFS_OK*) ;; *) echo "the app is back, but its settings were not restored: $out" >&2 ;; esac
"<root>/stubs/adb" -s 192.168.43.1:5555 shell "am start -n com.qualcomm.ftcrobotcontroller/org.firstinspires.ftc.robotcontroller.internal.PermissionValidatorWrapper"
